evidence.reason: The finding alleges that a non-JSON signer reply raises JSONDecodeError (a ValueError), escaping publish_ledger's OSError contract. At the pinned tip, crq.py already wraps json.loads(reply) in try/except ValueError and converts the decode failure into OSError("signer reply unreadable; retain publication outbox") (lines 244-247), exactly the mapping the finding requests. History shows commit 92765f6a6e0a8148e2d02d4fb28be96565e00d50 ("fix(crq-python): Treat an unreadable signer reply as OSError") implemented this fix.
